newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR index slips 1.58 points.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR index slips 1.58 points.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR index was 1.58 points or 1.99 percent down on Tuesday at 77.76, after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index fell 50.06 points or 1.4 percent to 3,530.23.

The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market stood at 13.71 percent. The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
